title: Ritmolux preset: analytic_field
description: The schema for a preset driving `analytic_field`, selected by a library filename beginning `analytic_`. Generated from the engine's own parameter and table declarations. Do not edit by hand: re-run the core test suite with RLX_UPDATE_PRESET_SCHEMA=1.

system.description: Which built-in scene this preset drives. Required.

name.description: Human-readable name; absent means the system's own name.

representative.description: Whether this preset is one of its family's samples for the narrowed test tier.
representative.markdownDescription:
Whether this preset is one of its family's samples for the narrowed test tier.

Default `false`.

params.description: One expression per named parameter; an unbound parameter keeps its default.

per_vertex.description: Bindings evaluated once per mesh vertex, with x/y/rad/ang in scope.

smoothing.description: Per-parameter easing in seconds; an unlisted parameter is applied instantly.

hold.description: Per-parameter sample-and-hold; an unlisted parameter is read every frame.

latch.description: Named armed-and-fired events an expression can read as a variable.

generator.description: The L-system's grammar or the star pattern's tiling, plus the preset's seed.

particles.description: The attractor family, its density, and what morph travels towards.

path.description: An authored silhouette for the shape field, as inline SVG path data.

spectrum.description: How the readout divides the frequency axis and what figure it forms.

mesh.description: The warp mesh's grid, in cells.

field.description: Which closed-form world the analytic field draws.

cellular.description: Which automaton the cellular system runs, and on how large a grid.

milk.description: A converted MilkDrop preset's compiled programs and shaders.

feedback.description: Which warp the accumulation buffers resample their past through, and how this frame is deposited onto it.

palette.description: The colour gradient; absent means the built-in spectrum.

palette_b.description: The crossfade target a bindable palette_mix travels towards.

occupancy.description: Parameters whose clamp bounds are meant to pin, exempted from the saturation gate.

layer.description: A second scene drawn with the first.
A second scene drawn with the first, with its own system, bindings and structure.

system.description: Which built-in scene the layer draws. Required.

join.description: Where the layer joins: into the main scene's target, or into the chain as its own image.
join.markdownDescription:
Where the layer joins: into the main scene's target, or into the chain as its own image.

Default `under`.

blend.description: How an over-joined layer blends into the chain. Inert on an under join.
blend.markdownDescription:
How an over-joined layer blends into the chain. Inert on an under join.

Default `screen`.

mix.description: The over junction's amount; absent means full strength.

params.description: The layer's own parameter bindings, namespaced to its scene.

per_vertex.description: The layer's per-vertex bindings, for a warp-mesh layer.

smoothing.description: Per-parameter easing for the layer's bindings.

hold.description: Per-parameter sample-and-hold for the layer's bindings.

generator.description: The layer's L-system grammar or star tiling.

cellular.description: The layer's automaton family and grid.

latch.description: A gate armed on one condition and fired by the first rising edge of another inside the arming window.

arm.description: While this holds above 0.5 the latch is armed; its fall re-arms it. Required.

fire.description: The rising edge that fires an armed latch. Required.

hold.description: How long the fired latch reads 1, in seconds. 0 is a single frame.
hold.markdownDescription:
How long the fired latch reads 1, in seconds. 0 is a single frame.

Default `0`.

curve.description: Which parametric family the curve scene samples.

generator.description: The L-system's grammar or the star pattern's tiling, plus the salt every system's hash() and noise() mix in.

axiom.description: L-system: the starting string. Required on an lsystem preset.

rules.description: L-system: production rules, each key a single predecessor character.

angle_deg.description: L-system: turn angle for + and -, in degrees.
angle_deg.markdownDescription:
L-system: turn angle for + and -, in degrees.

Default `25`.

max_depth.description: L-system: how many iterations to expand and cache.
max_depth.markdownDescription:
L-system: how many iterations to expand and cache.

Default `4`.

seed.description: The salt hash() and noise() mix into their argument; "random" draws one per launch and pins to 0 on every capture path.
seed.markdownDescription:
The salt hash() and noise() mix into their argument; "random" draws one per launch and pins to 0 on every capture path.

Default `0`.

tiling.description: Star pattern: the regular tiling the rosette is built on, or "none" for the ring ornament alone. Required on a star_pattern preset.

contact_angle_deg.description: Star pattern: the contact angle the interlace is struck at, in degrees.
contact_angle_deg.markdownDescription:
Star pattern: the contact angle the interlace is struck at, in degrees.

Default `30`.

rings.description: Star pattern: concentric rings of repeated motifs filling the interior.

ring.description: One ring of repeated motifs inside a star rosette.

radius.description: Distance from the frame centre to each copy's centre. Required.

phase.description: Angular offset of copy 0, in radians.
phase.markdownDescription:
Angular offset of copy 0, in radians.

Default `0`.

particles.description: Which strange attractor the compute-particle scene iterates, how much of the tier's budget it draws, and what morph travels towards.

family.description: The attractor family: one of the four maps, or an IFS figure. Required.

density.description: How much of the tier's particle budget is actually drawn. At or below 0.08 it is a fixed count - the tier's anchor times this - at every window size; at or above 0.16 it is a fraction of the budget, which grows with the render target. Between the two it scales partly with the window.
density.markdownDescription:
How much of the tier's particle budget is actually drawn. At or below 0.08 it is a fixed count - the tier's anchor times this - at every window size; at or above 0.16 it is a fraction of the budget, which grows with the render target. Between the two it scales partly with the window.

Default `1`.

morph_to.description: The IFS figure morph travels towards; absent pins the figure and makes morph inert. An error on a map family.

tuple_from.description: Map families: the near end of the tuple path morph walks, as a roster index.
tuple_from.markdownDescription:
Map families: the near end of the tuple path morph walks, as a roster index.

Default `0`.

tuple_to.description: Map families: the far end, and the key that turns the walk on. An error on an IFS figure.

path.description: An authored silhouette for the shape field, as inline SVG path data.

d.description: The contour, as SVG path data. Required.

morph_to.description: A second silhouette morph travels towards; absent makes morph inert.

samples.description: The arity both contours are resampled to, and what the per-pixel field costs O(N) in.
samples.markdownDescription:
The arity both contours are resampled to, and what the per-pixel field costs O(N) in.

Default `64`.

spectrum.description: How the readout divides the frequency axis, what figure the elements form, and how fast each element follows its band.

elements.description: Element count. A readout finer than the band array is refused.
elements.markdownDescription:
Element count. A readout finer than the band array is refused.

Default `24`.

layout.markdownDescription:
Which figure the elements form.

Default `bars`.

smoothing.description: Per-element easing in seconds, in the [smoothing] table's own vocabulary.
smoothing.markdownDescription:
Per-element easing in seconds, in the [smoothing] table's own vocabulary.

Default `0`.

mesh.description: The warp mesh's grid, in cells. Clamped to the tier at both consumers rather than at load.

field.description: Which closed-form world the analytic field draws.

family.description: The field family. Required inside the table; an absent table is chladni.

map.description: Escape time only: julia iterates from the pixel with c the constant, mandelbrot makes the pixel c.
map.markdownDescription:
Escape time only: julia iterates from the pixel with c the constant, mandelbrot makes the pixel c.

Default `julia`.

trap.description: Escape time only: colour each pixel by how near its orbit came to this shape instead of by how fast it escaped.
trap.markdownDescription:

cellular.description: Which automaton the cellular system runs, on how large a grid, and whether its edges wrap.

grid.description: Cells per side. A content value, not a resolution: doubling it halves how large every pattern looks.
grid.markdownDescription:
Cells per side. A content value, not a resolution: doubling it halves how large every pattern looks.

Default `256`.

wrap.description: Whether the grid is a torus; false makes every cell past the border dead.
wrap.markdownDescription:

per_frame.description: The once-per-frame program, as assembly text.

per_vertex.description: The once-per-mesh-vertex program, as assembly text.

waves.description: The custom waves, each with its own programs.

quantize_steps.description: The warp field's quantization, in steps.

init.description: The once-at-load program, as assembly text.

per_point.description: The once-per-point program, as assembly text.

instances.markdownDescription:

use_dots.description: Draw points rather than a connected line.
use_dots.markdownDescription:
Draw points rather than a connected line.

thick.markdownDescription:

additive.description: Add into the frame rather than blending over it.
additive.markdownDescription:
Add into the frame rather than blending over it.

feedback.description: Which curated warp the accumulation buffers resample their past through, and how this frame's light is deposited onto it.

warp.description: The warp the accumulation reads its previous frame through.
warp.markdownDescription:
The warp the accumulation reads its previous frame through.

Default `none`.

blend.description: How this frame is deposited: bounded by the source maximum, or summed.
blend.markdownDescription:
